hypothesis: A route-native opposite-direction signal used as close-only authority can improve the exact short-only SP500 or SNDK lifecycle versus stop/profit-lock/maximum-hold control, and one or more fixed V61 stops may sit inside normal route noise. Any wider stop must be paired with lower notional so configured maximum dollar risk does not increase.

route_exits.BTC: structural 20-75 bps stop plus 3R target for Hulk shorts; delayed component-floor profit lock on robust v3; liquidity-sweep long uses 60-bps stop and 60-bps target; 24-hour fallback
route_exits.ETH: 60-bps stop, eligible opposite strategy intent, no target or profit lock, 12-hour fallback
route_exits.SOL: short-only structural 20-75 bps stop plus 3R target, 24-hour fallback
route_exits.HYPE: 80-bps stop, eligible opposite strategy intent, regime-supported 8-hour soft hold with 24-hour hard fallback
route_exits.xyz:SP500: short-only 80-bps stop plus completed-one-minute-bar 100/40/80-bps trailing profit lock, 24-hour fallback
route_exits.xyz:SPCX: short-only 80-bps stop plus absolute cash-close anchor and provider recipe exit, 6-hour-15-minute fallback
route_exits.xyz:SNDK: short-only 80-bps stop, no target, no profit lock, 24-hour fallback
route_exits.xyz:BRENTOIL: 80-bps stop, eligible opposite strategy intent, no target or profit lock, 24-hour fallback

sndk_historical_lifecycles.identity_limitation: historical breakout-pressure proxy uses selected 120-bps-clamped stop and provider signal exits; it is not an exact V61 80-bps/no-recipe replay

live_trade_snapshot.limitation: the live checkpoint is mutable; the diagnostic output must embed the exact selected trade records and their own digest

close_only_opposite_signal.rule: the first later causal eligible long provider decision may close an existing short; it may never enter long, add, reverse, or act while route state is flat, stale, missing, or same-side

routes: each current V61 route with attributable stop lifecycles
equal_risk_stop_width.rule: notional is inversely resized against stop width so modeled maximum pre-cost dollar loss equals the route control
equal_risk_stop_width.whipsaw_definition: after a protective stop, the causal path recovers entry or reaches the original favorable objective before the original maximum-hold boundary

required: stressed net pnl improves over exact control
net pnl excluding the largest winner is nonnegative
no causal execution-data censoring invalidates the comparison
untouched nominal and stressed net pnl are positive
untouched stressed net pnl improves over control
net pnl excluding the largest winner is nonnegative
route identity and execution friction remain exact

falsifiers: higher dollar risk disguised as a wider stop
close-only intent can create or reverse a position
